description: Prompt for Copilot CLI to fix the problems of one ESLint rule, plus extra instructions per rule. Prompt lines are joined with a space. {ruleId} is replaced by the rule and {messageFile} by the file for the commit message. The {ruleInstructions} line is replaced by the rule-specific instructions in 'rules' (rule id -> list of lines joined with a space), or removed when the rule has none. Keep everything free of double quotes, backticks and shell characters (single quotes are fine): the prompt is passed through a shell inside double quotes.
prompt: Fix only the ESLint problems of the rule {ruleId} in this project.
Check them with: npx uselab-linting check '{ruleId}'. This is the check command. Keep the single quotes around the rule name, because PowerShell cannot parse an unquoted name that starts with @.
Do not change code for other rules.

Fix the root cause. Do not take shortcuts: do not disable the rule, do not add eslint-disable comments, do not change the ESLint config or ignores, do not use ts-ignore, any or type assertions to silence it. Git stage new files.
If you create new files or move files make sure they are tracked by Git.
Run the check command again after your changes until it reports no problems.
If you have difficulty fixing a problem, ask me for permission before commenting it out; never do that without my explicit permission.
When the check command reports no problems, write a one-line commit message that describes the fix to the file {messageFile}, then tell me to type /exit to return.

@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any: Replace any with the real type, a generic, or unknown with a type guard.
Prefer types that already exist in the project or its dependencies over new ones.
uselab-layout/file-location: Move the file into app/, features/ or support/ inside the src folder. Entry files such as main.ts belong in app/.
Update every import of the moved file so nothing breaks.
max-params: Booleans and numbers are usually better in a single object parameter than as separate parameters.
A single object parameter with properties for each boolean or number are better in many cases. It is more readable.
